composition.hash_semantics: sha256 binds ORIGINAL official7 source. patched_sha256 is hardcoded-UI-only output from original, never a composed final hash. Any future overlap requires reviewed order and step/final hashes; no last-writer replacement. Current5files do not overlap sidebar/title/Cowork/gate targets.
